name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly, not on the track, but in the bustling ports of Lisbon where he coordinated shipments for a racing team. This initial role sparked a fascination with the intricate logistics required to keep a team moving. He honed his skills by meticulously tracking parts, managing inventory, and ensuring timely deliveries across Europe. 

His approach to logistics is all about anticipating problems before they arise. Ricardo believes in detailed planning and clear communication with every member of the team. He is known for his tenacity and unwillingness to compromise on quality or efficiency. He prides himself on his ability to navigate complex international regulations and streamline the movement of equipment and personnel, ensuring everything arrives at the right place, at the right time, every time. Ricardo's dedication transforms logistical nightmares into seamless operations.

physical.description: A man of medium build, Ricardo's face is etched with the lines of someone who has seen it all, yet his eyes still hold a spark of youthful enthusiasm.

quirks: Always carries a meticulously organized notebook filled with schedules and contingency plans.
Insists on using physical maps alongside GPS, claiming it provides a better 'feel' for the journey.
Has a peculiar habit of polishing his glasses excessively when contemplating a particularly complex logistical challenge.
